message.content: Task K: callisto init translates a Changesets v2/v3 .changeset/config.json into callisto.toml. Worktree name wp-k-changesets-migration, trail #458. Read the plan row K and the Changesets migration section of .claude/plans/DESIGN-config-surface.md (main checkout). Owner decisions: fixed -> [[fixed-group]] with globs expanded to the current npm/<name> list and a warning that new packages must be added by hand; linked -> warn only (Callisto linked groups bump every member, Changesets only bumps members with changesets), no translation; ignore -> nothing written, keep the warning; access restricted or absent -> refuse to write without --yes, naming each scoped package that would publish as public (Callisto publishes scoped packages without publishConfig.access as public) and pointing to publishConfig.access; baseBranch -> the generated workflow branch filter, not a config key; updateInternalDependencies -> nothing. Report every ignored key. Test with real v2 and v3 config files. Use the existing --yes flag; ask the lead before adding any flag. Rules (from the lead session close-gap-for-alpha): Read AGENTS.md first and follow its invariant ladder: a type or private constructor first, then exhaustive match, then an existing lint, then one test at the real boundary; delete per-call-site checks the new type makes redundant and migrate every sibling call site in the same PR. No new traits, async, journals or frameworks; no new error codes, JSON keys or flags without asking the lead first. Work in a named worktree off fresh origin/main (EnterWorktree name=<given>). Write the failing test first. Gate by exit code: just pre-push, just lint, just doc-check, just test, just ci; cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff on the Rust diff with zero missed or argued equivalents in the PR body; never commit mutants.out* (restore mutants.out.old from HEAD only if tracked). Run one fresh Opus reviewer subagent on the diff and apply what holds up. Changeset via `cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add --package cargo/callisto-cli:<bump> --summary "..."` only for user-visible changes, written for users. Signed commits, no session trailer. Right before pushing, merge the latest origin/main (no rebase, no force-push) and re-run the gates if it moved. Push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>, confirm with git ls-remote, link to the given Entire trail and open with entire trail ci-pr. If Entire raises findings, fix the ones that cause a wrong result, broken recovery, a security issue or a check that cannot fail; report the rest to the lead. Resolve a finding only after the fix is on the remote. When done, send the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) one report: PR number, sha, gates run, and anything not verified. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is cores/5; never run two cargo builds in one worktree.

file.content:
- Code: as in the table, plus `cli/commands/init.rs:517-545`, `InitArgs` and their tests.
  - Tests: `release_forge_repository_tests.rs`, `release_config_hardening_tests.rs`.
  - Docs and specs: `docs/config.md:58,69`, `docs/errors.md:232,240,242,283,312`, REL-AUTH-09, CLI-INIT-03/10/12, VER-APPLY-07A, `cli.json:58,66`.
- Boundary test to write first: a fixture with origin `github.com/o/r`, `[release]` without the key, and `release plan --artifact-repository o/r` succeeds with slots targeting `o/r`. The same fixture with no origin fails with E198.

## 5. Group `members` globs: no

- Members resolve exactly. An unknown member is an error with a suggestion (`groups.rs:155-197`).
- `PackagePattern` could match globs, but a new package matching `npm/@acme/*` would silently join a fixed group and jump to the group's version (VER-GRP-01). A glob's meaning drifts as packages are added.
- Explicit lists also keep E109, E249 and E250 conflict detection exact.

## Changesets migration (WP K)

The new shape barely changes K. Only item 5 matters: K must expand globs.

| Changesets key | K writes | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `fixed` | `[[fixed-group]]`, globs expanded to the current `npm/<name>` list | Warn that new packages must be added by hand |
| `linked` | **Decision needed** | Changesets bumps only packages with changesets. Callisto bumps every member (VER-GRP-03). Translating changes behavior. |
| `ignore` | Nothing; keep the warning | A glob `[[package]] publish-to = ["none"]` still versions the package, so it is not equivalent |
| `access` | Nothing in `callisto.toml` | **Hazard:** Callisto publishes scoped packages without `publishConfig.access` as public (`derive.rs:1456-1488`). Changesets' default is `restricted`. K must flag every such package. |
| `baseBranch` | The generated workflow's branch filter, not a config key | — |
| `updateInternalDependencies` | Nothing | ADR 10 always raises co-released dependents' ranges |

## Measured value

Non-blank, non-comment lines. Sample files were written in `$TMPDIR` and parsed with `tomllib`.

| Config | Before | After | Δ | From |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ours | 44 | 31 | −13 | Item 3: −12; item 4: −1 |
| Changesets-style npm monorepo (2 groups, 2 globs, 1 exact, no binaries) | 17 | 17 | 0 | Item 2 only renames a table |
| Mixed Cargo/npm/PyPI, private cargo registry, split PyPI URLs, 6 targets + Windows zip + plugin artifact | 51 | 38 | −13 | Item 3: −12; item 4: −1; items 1 and 2: 0 |

- Items 1 and 2 save no lines; their value is in the Verdict table.
- Ours also carries `[changesets] dir = ".changeset"`, which is the default: 2 free lines.

## Migration

- What an existing user sees on upgrade:
  - `[[package-set]]` and `[registries.cratesIo]` fail at load with E325, and the message names the new spelling.
  - `publish-to = ["nuget"]` gives E330.
  - The JSON diagnostic `package-set-matched-nothing` disappears.
  - `forge-repository` and `[[release.artifact]]` keep working.
  - `init --forge-repository` becomes an unknown flag.

9:Retired codes, no longer emitted and never reused: E008, E050, E187, E195, E248, E253, E254, E257, E258. E254 once covered every invalid `callisto.toml` value, under the name "unknown key"; an unknown key is E325, and each value condition now has its own code (E330 to E338).
72:| E290 | Release intent repeats a release operation | list each release operation at most once |
73:| E291 | Release intent operation's prerequisites are not in canonical order | re-derive the intent instead of hand-editing prerequisite order |
74:| E292 | Release intent operation requires an unknown prerequisite | only reference prerequisites that are also in the intent's operation list |
75:| E293 | Release intent operation requires itself as a prerequisite | remove the operation from its own prerequisite list |
76:| E294 | Release intent operation DAG contains a cycle | break the prerequisite cycle among release operations |
77:| E295 | Unsupported release intent (or nested decision/snapshot) wire schema version | re-derive this file with the current build; a release-intent wire shape is never reused across versions |
78:| E296 | Release intent's input snapshot packages are not canonical | re-derive the intent instead of hand-editing package order |
79:| E297 | Release intent digest does not match its canonical content | re-derive the intent instead of hand-editing its fields |
150:| E249 | Two different groups both list the same member | List the member in only one group; remove it from all but one. |
251:| E245 | `pre.json` records a bare name that now names several packages, and none was the only one when `pre.json` was added | In `pre.json` `initialVersions`, rename the `<key>` key to the qualified id of the package it was recorded for. |
252:| E246 | Version dependency edge involves incompatible version grammars | Use the same version grammar on both sides of the dependency edge, or drop the edge. |
253:| E247 | On-disk versions changed since the version plan was generated | Regenerate the version plan against the current workspace state before applying it. |
291:| E240 | stdin is not a terminal, so `init` needs flags instead of prompts, and required flags are missing | re-run `callisto init --yes` with the listed flags, or run it in a terminal to be asked |
292:| E241 | `init --yes` is missing required flag(s) | supply the listed flags; see `callisto init --help` |
293:| E242 | `--workflow` and `--no-workflow` are mutually exclusive | pass only one of --workflow or --no-workflow |
294:| E243 | `pre enter` was run while `.changeset/pre.json`'s mode is already `pre` | run `callisto pre exit` first |
295:| E244 | `pre exit` was run with no `.changeset/pre.json` on disk | callisto pre enter <tag> |
310:| E298 | `init --product-package` given without `--artifact-target` | drop --<flag>, or pass --artifact-target to ship the product's binaries |
311:| E299 | `init --workflow`/`--artifact-target` given with no `origin` remote configured | add the repository's remote as `origin` (`git remote add origin <url>`), then re-run init |
| E274 | `add --package` was given with no `--summary` in non-interactive mode | pass `--summary "description"` alongside `--package` |
| E275 | `add --summary` is empty or whitespace-only | provide a non-empty description of the change |
| E276 | `version --emit-decision` or `--emit-preview` was run with `--dry-run`, but emitting the file writes it | remove --dry-run, or drop --<flag> |
| E277 | `--strict` escalated one or more workspace graph diagnostics to errors | resolve each listed diagnostic, or drop --strict if it is expected |
| E279 | `pre enter` was given an empty or whitespace-only tag | pass a non-empty tag, for example `callisto pre enter beta` |
| E280 | `pre exit` was run after prerelease mode was already exited | run `callisto version` to finalize the release |
| E281 | A `release-pr` `--decision`/`--snapshot` argument given inline or on stdin is not valid JSON | check the JSON is well-formed and matches the expected schema |
| E282 | `release-pr commit-plan` was run with both `--out` and `--dry-run` | re-run without --dry-run, or drop --out |
| E283 | `help` named a subcommand that doesn't exist | run `callisto --help` to list commands |
| E298 | `init --product-package` given without `--artifact-target` | drop --<flag>, or pass --artifact-target to ship the product's binaries |
| E299 | `init --workflow`/`--artifact-target` given with no `origin` remote configured | add the repository's remote as `origin` (`git remote add origin <url>`), then re-run init |
| E308 | `release build-python` or `artifact-manifest --seal-python` on an intent that publishes no Python package, `release pack-npm` or `--seal-npm` on one that publishes no npm package, or `release package-cargo` on one that publishes no crate | drop --seal-python and `release build-python` for an intent without a Python publish, --seal-npm and `release pack-npm` for one without an npm publish, or `release package-cargo` for one without a crate publish |
| E309 | `release build-python`, `release pack-npm` or `release package-cargo` run with `--dry-run`, which cannot write build output | re-run `callisto release <command>` without --dry-run |
| E310 | Failed to read manifest `<path>`: <message> | Make the manifest readable UTF-8 text; a workspace member's manifest is never skipped. |
| E311 | Invalid workspace membership in `<path>`: <message> | Make `members`/`exclude` (Cargo, uv) or `workspaces`/`packages` (npm, pnpm) an array of valid glob strings; Callisto will not guess which packages a malformed workspace admits. |
| E312 | Package `<path>` is reached through a symbolic link, which Git cannot stage | Replace the link with the real directory, or list it in a .gitignore under the workspace root so discovery skips it; Callisto cannot commit a version bump to a file beneath a symbolic link. |
| E313 | The workspace is incomplete: N manifest(s) could not be resolved | Fix or remove the manifests named above and re-run; Callisto will not plan a release from a partial workspace. |
| E314 | Cannot apply the version plan: N file(s) cannot be written, so nothing was changed | Fix the files named above (a missing file, permissions, a symbolic link Git cannot stage, or a path a .gitignore ignores) and re-run; no manifest, changelog or changeset was touched. |

169:## Identity and defaults
`[[fixed-group]]`: all members bump in lock-step from the group's alignment base. `[[linked-group]]`: every member receives the highest severity and aligns to the highest target version produced by the members' bumps. Both currently require compatible version grammars; neither is an automatic cross-language version converter.

Example (this repo's own `callisto.toml`):
```toml
[[fixed-group]]
name = "workspace"

```

## Identity and defaults

Unspecified package fields are filled during graph construction: the release trigger defaults to changesets, the changelog to the package directory, and publish targets to those declared by its manifests. Default tags use the display id, so newly created tags become qualified after name promotion; historical bare tags use the ownership fallback described in [identity](architecture/identity.md). `callisto init` translates a Changesets v2/v3 `.changeset/config.json` (trail #458, WP K).

- `fixed` becomes `[[fixed-group]]` (`fixed-<n>`), globs and `!` exclusions expanded to the current npm packages; the warning says new packages must be added by hand.
- `linked`, `ignore` and `updateInternalDependencies` are not translated; every other non-empty key (`changelog`, `commit`, `privatePackages`, unknown keys) gets one `changesets-config-key-dropped` warning. Empty `fixed`, `linked`, `ignore` and `$schema` drop nothing and stay silent.
- `baseBranch` sets the generated workflow's branch filter, for a fresh init and for `init --workflow`.
- `access` restricted or absent: without `--yes`, init refuses with new E342, naming each scoped npm package that Callisto would publish as public; `--dry-run` previews with the warning instead. No new flags or JSON keys.
- Docs: `docs/config.md` migration table, E342 in `docs/errors.md`, CLI-INIT-14 and CLI-INIT-17 in the CLI spec.

Checks: `cargo test -p callisto-graph`, `cargo test -p callisto-cli`, `just lint` and `just doc-check` exit 0 after merging main. `just ci` and `just verify-real` were not run locally.

Mutation testing: `cargo mutants --in-place` on `changesets.rs` (36 mutants): 29 caught, 7 unviable, 0 missed, none argued equivalent. An earlier run on the full Rust diff found 3 missed, each now covered by a test; the diff has not been re-run in full since.

Not decided here: `baseBranch` always overrides the detected default branch, so a repo on `master` with the untouched `changeset init` default `main` gets a workflow for `main`. The chosen branch is printed during init.

input.content:
---
callisto-cli: minor
---

**`callisto init` migrates a Changesets config.**
Switch an `@changesets/cli` 2.x or 3.x repository to Callisto without rewriting its groups or release branch by hand.

- **Why it matters:** `init` reads `.changeset/config.json` and reports every setting it did not carry over, so none goes silently inert.
- **How to adopt:** run `callisto init` in the repository.
  - Translated:
    - `fixed` becomes `[[fixed-group]]` entries, with globs expanded to the npm packages that exist now.
    - `baseBranch` becomes the branch filter of the generated release workflow.
  - Reported, not translated:
    - `linked`, `ignore` and `updateInternalDependencies`.
    - Any other non-empty key, such as `changelog` or `commit`.
- **Limits:**
  - Add packages created after `init` to the fixed groups by hand.
  - `linked` is not translated: a Callisto linked group bumps every member on each release, while Changesets bumps only members with changesets.

**Action:** if `access` is `restricted` or absent and a scoped npm package has no `publishConfig.access`, `init` refuses (E342) unless you pass `--yes`, because Callisto publishes such packages as public. Set `publishConfig.access` in each listed package.json, or pass `--yes`.
